text:
matt: urgent POC blocker: when customer runs json_mode=strict + streaming, fn_call outputs sometimes show required numeric fields as null. demo in 16h, need a quick mitigation.

sara: can you paste a redacted failing payload and headers? is streaming definitely enabled?

matt: posted a redacted sample to the ticket: ```{"tool":"billing_parser","name":"parse","arguments":{"bill_id":"B-900","amount":null}}``` streaming=true; model=r-infer-1-large; req=r-1234xyz; max_output_tokens=400. Happens ~10% runs.

vikram: three likely causes: (1) mid-stream truncation -> strict parser coerces missing numbers to null, (2) model emits placeholders like "N/A" or words that coercer can't parse, (3) charset/BOM offset problems. any raw_response samples with trailing text?

matt: customer attached a raw_response that contains `}\nNote: see line items` after the JSON object in some failures.

ops-bot: [connector] 1819990020 WARN tls upstream err=\"verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate\"

sec-bot: TLS logs indicate their inspection proxy might be terminating TLS and not presenting a full chain. For demo options: (A) passthrough for our endpoints, (B) import our CA in their appliance, or (C) allowlist our egress IPs. Passthrough is fastest.

vikram: immediate mitigations for demo (low friction): 1) request non-streaming runs for the demo, 2) add an explicit end-of-json sentinel in the prompt like "<END_JSON>", 3) require the model to return only a ```json``` fenced object, 4) disable strict coercion temporarily and use tolerant parsing.

sara: engineering can also ship a tenant-scoped tolerant post-processor that extracts the first balanced top-level JSON via bracket-scan and strips trailing garbage, plus normalization for placeholders ("N/A","\u2014","NaN") and simple words-to-number attempts. estimate ~1 dev-day behind a feature flag.

matt: sales question: customer is worried token cost will spike if we switch to non-streaming or enable retries. how to position?

sara: say: "temporary mitigation for demo; token impact minimal at demo QPS; engineering will provide an estimate from sample traces; sales can offer a short demo credit if needed."

eng-oncall: quick dev tips: (a) if numeric fields are null, try coercing quoted numbers and common word forms before returning null, (b) detect charset/BOM and transcode to utf-8 before parsing, (c) log raw_response_base64 and normalization decisions for debugging (with customer consent).

vikram: i'll scope HOTFIX: tolerant-json-extractor feature flag, 24h ETA. will include rollback plan.

matt: i'll ask the customer for raw_response (base64 ok), exact prompt/system messages, headers (Content-Type charset), and proxy cert chain/logs. also offer the sentinel + non-streaming run while we ship the hotfix.

sara: i'll draft customer message and pricing note. ops-bot: create ticket for hotfix.

ops-bot: action created HOTFIX-2021 tolerant-json-extractor assigned to vikram, due 24h.

matt: thanks team  ping me when flag is live and i'll validate with a sample run.
